evidence: Built a criterion->public-requirement map for all 28 criteria (2 gates, 16 functional, 6 polish, 4 visual). Every graded demand traces to public text: plain 'not available' refusals and every wall route (walls-and-retention.md L17, applied to clients L17 last sentence; signin Part B, wall_every_route legs 3-5, wall_mentions_and_links); signed-out data denial (instruction.md L7, integration.md L9); live wall within ~10 s keeping other matters (walls L15,L19); 3-level nesting, in-order siblings and parent quotes (conversations.md L5); deleted-parent placeholder in thread/transcript (conversations L9, walls L25, L35); exact 7-day boundary, editing doesn't rejuvenate, shorten deletes at once, off/lengthen never restores, partner-only timer with off/1/7/30 options shown beside title (walls L23); hold scope/delete-block/release-applies-timer/'On hold' text not a mark (walls L29, conversations L13); stale edit refusal keeping typed text with a persistent nearby reason (conversations L9, walls L37); earlier versions literal (conversations L13); mention add/remove on edit/delete, first-name any-case, @ suggestions limited to viewers (conversations L21); link preview/not-available/open-at-message/highlight that persists (conversations L17); unread same in every tab, line, mark-unread, deleted not counted (conversations L25); idempotent resend and same-time order across thread/search/transcript (conversations L31); live updates not disturbing draft/scroll/open reply (L33); case-insensitive literal %/_/* search without earlier versions (walls L33); transcript heading/time/authors/sent times/versions/no chat controls (walls L35, integration L7 'Show times in UTC'); persistence of all listed state (integration L5); Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape/delete-confirm (conversations L9, L29); 390 px no sideways scroll (conversations L35). No criterion prescribes routes, payload shapes, labels or selectors (functional prompt.md L62 'Any endpoint path, payload shape or cookie name is acceptable'; render prompt 'Judge observable outcomes rather than exact wording'). Likely false-fail sources are explicitly relaxed: W3 cross-matter reply accepts refusal or filing under its own parent's matter (functional judge.toml L66); version viewer leg is conditional (L138, L140); suggestion replay only 'if showing the suggestions made a request' (L81); replays changing text must change any duplicate-send key (prompt L45-46) and stale-edit replay uses the current version so only authorship explains refusal (L174); visual matter_sidebar accepts list beside thread or separate screen and ignores absent counts. Sign-in/sign-out is house convention (workbook E28, SKILL.md L63) and the brief itself names sign-in. Conforming alternatives probed: collapsed/expandable reply threads (still 'under' the parent; judge may expand), Slack-style hidden badge on the open matter (excluded by public 'same in every tab'), token-based FTS (excluded by 'exactly the characters typed' and literal %,_,*), non-URL message references (a 'link' you 'follow' and 'open' is a URL by professional default), server 403 'walled' messages (public text demands plain 'not available'). None is a credible correct app that a criterion would wrongly fail. test.sh symlink rule is laxer than the brief (allows node_modules-internal links), so it cannot false-fail a conforming app. Weak app that could pass: none found for this row's scope (row 27 concerns over-demand, not under-coverage). Limits: static mapping only; the raw evidence index states no configured judge run/Oracle exists for these bytes (hosted v2 Oracle 0.9917 was on previous bytes). Minor notes, not defects: unread leg 'within about ten seconds' for read-state sync is inferred from 'same in every tab' plus the 10-second live window; search_and_transcript Part C in-word match 'urvey booked' relies on 'exactly the characters typed'; link_highlight assumes a copied link is a navigable address.
